slices.focus: During a rare quiet pocket, Eric reads a Michael Connelly paperback on the porch instead of checking work messages, rediscovering crime fiction as a decompression tool that fits his tired-evening bandwidth better than practical nonfiction.
slices.summary: Eric discovers that Michael Connelly novels from Danielle's library discard shelf provide a more realistic evening decompression routine than practical nonfiction, leading to a phone-down, porch-chair, one-chapter habit.
open_loops: Whether to establish an ongoing pipeline for Connelly books through Danielle
Phone management (face-down vs another room) not yet decided
decisions: Eric still reads practical nonfiction, but during the stressful pilot stretch he began reaching more often for Michael C
